elsewhere.note: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No…
